description: While in sojourn in Germany, Rizal sketched the view of the public square where the Schauspielhaus (Concert Hall), the Französischer Dom (French Cathedral), and the Deutscher Dom (German Cathedral) are located.

images.alt: Framed pencil drawing of the Gendarmenmarkt in Berlin, showing the domed cathedral beside a colonnaded hall
